name: Sunita's Homemade Achaar & Papad
tagline: Homemade achaar and papad from Vijay Nagar, Indore
about: I'm Sunita, and I make achaar and papad at home in Vijay Nagar, Indore. We mostly make mango, nimbu and mirchi achaar, all in mustard oil with no preservatives, following dadi's recipe. Orders are taken on WhatsApp only. We deliver within Indore in 2-3 days, and outside Indore by courier at extra cost.
hours: Open 11 am to 7 pm, Monday to Saturday. Closed on Sunday.
